rationale: The host default has the lowest historical hindcast error, and verified post-update evidence supports its effectively flat forecast shape by documenting a stationary, low-variance lower plateau from the forecast start. Although the evidence weakens its seasonal interpretation, it does not support any competing candidate: the other low-valued candidates also assume periodicity, while the quadratic candidate contradicts the stable regime. The scheduled shutdown lacks a quantified effect or end time, so it cannot justify a numeric override.
